appTagline: Local-farkon allo na sa ido don Windows
appDescription: Fahimtar inda lokacinku ya tafi. Hora yana bin aikace-aikace masu aiki da wuraren bincike a cikin gida, baya aika bayanai zuwa sabar, kuma yana taimaka muku haɓaka halaye na dijital lafiya.
dashboardSubtitle: Lokacin allo mai aiki wanda aka auna cikin gida akan wannan na'urar.
dashboardEmpty: Babu wani aiki da aka yi rikodin tukuna. Hora yana fara kirgawa da zarar kun yi amfani da PC ɗin ku.
dashboardEmptyHint: Ci gaba Hora yana gudana a cikin tire don samun ingantaccen sakamako.
dashboardPrivacy: Yanayin sirri yana ɓoye taken taga don manajan kalmar sirri da wuraren banki.
dashboardTrackingNote: Hora yana yin samfurin taga na gaba kowane daƙiƙa kuma yana adana tsawon lokaci.
historySubtitle: Jimillar yau da kullun na kwanaki bakwai na ƙarshe.
settingsSubtitle: Keɓance Hora, sarrafa ɗabi'a, da sarrafa bayanan ku.
settingsThemeHelp: Zabi palette. Ana amfani da launin lafazin a duk faɗin app ɗin.
settingsThemeCustomHelp: Shigar da launi na hexadecimal kamar 7C8CF8.
settingsThemeInvalid: Shigar da ingantacciyar launi hexadecimal, misali 7C8CF8.
settingsZoomHelp: Ma'auni na rubutu da sarrafawa daga kashi 80 zuwa 150.
settingsFontScaleHelp: Ƙarin ma'auni na rubutu don ingantaccen karatu.
settingsLanguageHelp: Maganin sadarwa yana canzawa nan take. Ana amfani da harshen Windows a farkon farawa.
settingsStartWithWindowsHelp: Kaddamar da Hora ta atomatik lokacin da ka shiga.
settingsSilentStartHelp: Ci gaba da Hora a cikin tire ba tare da buɗe taga ba.
settingsCloseTray: Ci gaba da gudu a cikin tire
settingsHotkeyHelp: Nuna ko boye Hora daga ko'ina. Misali: Ctrl+Alt+H.
settingsHotkeyInvalid: Wannan gajeriyar hanyar ba za a iya yin rijista ba. Gwada wani haɗin gwiwa.
settingsJumpListHelp: Yana ƙara ayyuka masu sauri zuwa menu na danna dama-dama.
settingsTrayIconHelp: Tallafin da aka zaɓa ya shafi taga, taskbar, tire, da gajeriyar hanyar tebur.
settingsNotificationsHelp: Nuna sanarwar lokacin farawa, daidaitawa, ko sabuntawa.
settingsSoundHelp: Kunna ɗan gajeren sauti tare da sanarwa.
settingsUpdatesError: Ba a iya isa ga sabunta sabis ɗin. A sake gwadawa daga baya.
settingsUpdatesReady: Mai sakawa ya fara. Hora zai rufe.
settingsResetHelp: Mayar da abubuwan da suka dace ba tare da share bayanan amfani ba.
settingsResetConfirm: Sake saita kowane saitin zuwa ƙimar sa ta asali?
backupSubtitle: Ajiye kwafin saitunanku mai ɗaukar hoto da bayanan amfani a cikin babban fayil ɗin girgije, ba tare da asusu ko sabar ba.
backupProviderHelp: Hora ya rubuta zuwa babban fayil wanda abokin cinikin ku ya riga ya daidaita. Babu OAuth kuma ba a buƙatar biyan kuɗi.
backupAutoSyncHelp: Ana adana saituna da bayanan martaba jim kaɗan bayan kowane canji, kuma sau ɗaya idan Hora ta rufe.
backupFolderFallback: Ba a samo OneDrive ba. Hora yana amfani da amintaccen babban fayil na gida maimakon.
backupSyncFailed: Ba a iya kammala wariyar ajiya ba. Bayananku yana da aminci akan wannan na'urar.
backupRestoreConfirm: Mayar da madadin daga {0}? Za a maye gurbin saitunan yanzu.
backupRestoreFailed: Ba a iya dawo da wariyar ajiya ba. An adana kwafin baya.
backupDisconnectConfirm: Cire haɗin wannan babban fayil ɗin madadin? Fayilolin da suka wanzu sun kasance ba a taɓa su ba.
backupRecoveryBody: An sami ingantaccen madadin Hora a cikin {0}. Maida shi yanzu ko fara sabo.
backupProtected: Ba a taɓa rubuta bayanan da ba komai a kan ingantaccen madadin.
diagnosticsSubtitle: Duba muhallin, gudanar da binciken lafiya, da shirya rahoton tallafi.
diagnosticsCheckBackup: Ajiyayyen babban fayil ana iya rubutawa
diagnosticsRedact: An gajarta hanyoyin sirri a cikin rahotannin da aka kwafi.
docsSubtitle: Duk abin da kuke buƙata don samun mafi kyawun Hora.
docsGettingStartedBody: Hora yana farawa da Windows kuma yana zaune a cikin tire. Bude dashboard don ganin jimlar yau, canza shimfidu, da dakatar da bin diddigin lokacin da kuke buƙatar keɓantawa.
docsTrackingBody: Hora yana gwada taga mai aiki kowane daƙiƙa kuma yana adana sunan aikace-aikacen, yankin bincike na zaɓi, da tsawon lokaci. Lokacin aiki, kulle-kulle, da taro ana gudanar da su daban.
docsBackupBody: Zaɓi OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive, ko kowane babban fayil. Hora yana adana hoton da aka ɗauka na yanzu, hoton da ya gabata, da abubuwan adanawa na yau da kullun guda goma sha biyar, kuma baya sake rubutawa mai kyau madadin tare da bayanan komai.
docsPrivacyBody: Babu ​​telemetry, babu asusu, babu sabar gajimare. Duk ma'aunai suna tsayawa akan wannan na'urar sai dai idan kun kunna babban fayil ɗin ajiya a sarari.
docsSupportBody: Bude Diagnostics don gudanar da gwaje-gwajen lafiya da kwafin rahoto. Ana adana rajistan ayyukan a cikin babban fayil ɗin bayanan gida kuma kada ku bar PC ɗinku ta atomatik.
aboutSubtitle: Hanya mai kwantar da hankali, gida-farko don fahimtar lokacin allo.
aboutBuiltWith: Gina tare da NET, WPF, da SQLite. Babu nazari, babu pixels masu bin diddigi, babu asusu.
aboutCreditsBody: Designira da injiniya ta Vellium. Gumaka da misalai ayyuka ne na asali.
legalPrivacyBody: Hora yana tattara tsawon lokacin amfani da aikace-aikacen da wuraren bincike na zaɓi akan na'urarka. Ana rubuta bayanai zuwa bayanan SQLite na gida kuma ba a taɓa watsawa ta atomatik. Ana ƙirƙira fayilolin Ajiyayyen a cikin babban fayil ɗin da kuka zaɓa kawai. Kuna iya share duk bayanai a kowane lokaci daga Saituna ko ta cire babban fayil ɗin bayanan aikace-aikacen.
legalTermsBody: An bayar da Hora kamar yadda yake, ba tare da garantin kowane iri ba. Kuna da alhakin yadda kuke amfani da ma'auni da kuma bin dokokin gida da manufofin wurin aiki. Kar a yi amfani da Hora don sa ido kan wasu mutane ba tare da izininsu ba.
legalLicenseBody: An saki Hora a ƙarƙashin lasisin MIT. Kuna iya amfani da, kwafi, gyara, da rarraba software, muddin an haɗa sanarwar haƙƙin mallaka da sanarwar izini.
wizardLanguageBody: Hora yana magana da harsuna 73. Kuna iya canza wannan daga baya a cikin Saituna.
wizardThemeBody: Zabi haske, duhu, ko bi Windows. Ana iya daidaita kowane palette tare da launi na al'ada.
wizardWelcomeBody: Hora a hankali yana auna inda lokacin allo ya tafi, yana adana komai akan wannan PC, kuma yana taimaka muku lura da alamu ba tare da hukunci ba.
wizardTourBody: Dashboard yana nuna jimlar yau da manyan aikace-aikacen ku. Shafin tarihi ya kwatanta kwanakin bakwai na ƙarshe. Saituna sun ƙunshi jigogi, harshe, gajerun hanyoyi, da keɓantawa. Ajiyayyen yana adana kwafi a cikin babban fayil ɗin girgije na ku.
wizardPrivacyNote: Babu ​​account. Babu telemetry. Babu uwar garken gajimare.
trayHintBody: Tagan a boye. Danna gunkin tire sau biyu don sake buɗe shi.
notifyWelcomeBody: Bibiya yana aiki. Bude dashboard don ganin ranar ku.
notifySyncBody: An adana bayanan ku zuwa babban fayil ɗin ajiyar waje.
closeAskBody: Ci gaba Hora yana gudana a cikin tire don ci gaba da bin diddigin, ko fita gaba ɗaya.
systemInfoCopied: Bayanan tsarin da aka kwafe zuwa allo.
reportCopied: Rahoton tallafi da aka kwafi zuwa allo.
openFolderFailed: Ba a iya buɗe babban fayil ɗin ba.
unknownError: Wani abu ya faru. Da fatan za a sake gwadawa.
settingsBehaviorHelp: Farawa, rufewa, gajeriyar hanya, da gunki.
diagnosticsLogsHelp: An nuna shigarwar ƙarshe na yau a ƙasa. Ana gyara hanyoyin.
installerSectionStart: Ƙirƙiri gajeriyar hanyar menu na Fara.
installerSectionStartup: Fara Hora shiru a cikin tire idan Windows ta fara.
installerAlreadyInstalled: An riga an shigar da Hora. Cire sigar da ta gabata kuma a ci gaba?
installerRequiresWindows10: Hora yana buƙatar Windows 10 ko sabo.
installerUninstallConfirm: Cire Hora daga wannan PC? Ana adana bayanan amfanin ku sai dai idan kun share su daga Saituna.
installerWelcomeIntro: Wannan mayen yana girka Hora, mai lura da lokacin allo na gida-farko.
installerWelcomePrivacy: Hora yana adana bayanan amfani kawai akan wannan PC. Babu lissafi, babu telemetry, babu sabar gajimare.
installerFinishText: An gama shigarwa. Danna Gama don rufe wannan mayen.
